noDrums.prompt: Dusty boom-bap production, heavy swing. A chopped soul sample loop, crunchy snare, deep swing, crackle between the hits. 90s studio with tape machines and samplers, dusty breaks, warm low-mids. No percussion, pulse carried by bass and repeated figures. One magnetic loop repeated until it becomes a world. Featuring woody upright bass, warm Rhodes electric piano with tremolo and turntable scratches as rhythmic texture. Plus chopped horn stabs from an old soul record. Raw worked sound, amp hiss, finger noise and small accidents left in, warm analog saturation on the bus, harmonics thick. Dark tense harmony, minor color, dissonant pulls, hypnotic insistent repetition. Natural room ambience. Structure: hypnotic repetition, slow evolving layers, no climax, trance through insistence. Mood: nocturnal and defiant, swaggering. Around 92 BPM, in C minor. Sound with identity and grain, every texture physical and close, pulse with a real engine.

Heavy chopped breakbeat, gritty sampler texture, lazy swing, laid-back human timing, sitting behind the beat. An unforgettable bass figure is the hook. Raw worked sound, amp hiss, finger noise and small accidents left in, warm analog saturation on the bus, harmonics thick. Mood: nocturnal and quietly menacing. Around 78 BPM, in D minor. Mix with physical presence and human friction, characterful drums, bass with weight.
